scenarios.requiredObservation: Current authorized entry, denied/expired entry and direct URLs preserve scope; no cached grant.
Select building, floor, room; switch Plan/3D and back; verify intended selection/camera retention, overlays, unknowns and source dates.

scenarios.journey: Keyboard, touch, wheel and small landscape
scenarios.requiredObservation: Named controls, focus, Escape, touch/pan/wheel and short landscape remain usable; verify stored refresh during an open detail surface.
Login/close/reopen/back/forward, scope change and lost response preserve honest state; unknown effects never imply safe replay.

scenarios.journey: Independent source outages and first generation
scenarios.requiredObservation: Retain last complete permitted generation and original success dates; first-run unavailable stays explicit; no collection demand.
After separately authorized preparation, terminate the app, remove network availability and cold-launch the installed icon; distinguish public shell from retained private content.

scenarios.journey: Choose exact retained pack and reopen
scenarios.requiredObservation: Select a verified saved copy, reload/reopen after process termination and verify snapshot/local revision, capture date, exclusions and all listed resource bytes.

scenarios.journey: Saved complete model, plans and room map
scenarios.requiredObservation: Verify GLB, exact raw companion, plans and optional room-links closure; absent map/model stays explicit; no inferred placement.

scenarios.journey: Saved records, inventory and logical overlays
scenarios.requiredObservation: Every claimed retained section opens with dates, uncertainty, supported coverage and honest unplaced counts; source metadata is not attachment bytes.

scenarios.journey: Saved originals, previews and PDF references
scenarios.requiredObservation: Verify original size/MIME/digest and explicit download; preview/reference availability stays separate; invalid recorded PDF page cannot show substitute pixels.

scenarios.journey: Missing, partial, unavailable and unconfigured pack
scenarios.requiredObservation: No copy is not an empty complete home; downloaded partial coverage remains partial. Every non-null reference has listed verified bytes.
Browser storage failure/eviction is visible; no durability or backup guarantee; replacement/removal retires stale views and file URLs.

scenarios.journey: Stale copies, worker updates and live return
scenarios.requiredObservation: Distinguish stored live model cache from Saved copies; record shell/controller/build identity across reopen; live return does not replay drafts.
Consume owner-qualified original/proposal/base/conflict behavior; local draft is unsubmitted, never an automatic replay queue.
Privately bind existing roles to allowed home/source actions and verify separation; no new membership, grants or invitations.

scenarios.journey: Native edit conflict, repeated action and lost receipt
scenarios.requiredObservation: Use owner-qualified exact write scope and outcome correlation; stop on unknown effects and inspect before retry. Separate authorization required.
Use exact owner-qualified measurement subset, provenance/history and model-change results; unsupported dimensions remain excluded.
Consume qualified application/caller/delivery handoff; verify status and compatible rollback explanation without authorizing a deployment.
Consume exact owner-qualified capture/cancel/original/PDF result; camera and native effects require separate resumption.
Confirm identity-bound unsent state, one explicit foreground send and unknown-outcome handling from owning issue.
Consume supported runtime/account lifecycle and operation matrix; unsupported phone/runtime actions are explicit exclusions; no paid call.
Verify exact reviewed evidence/map association; ambiguous records remain unplaced and physical wiring unknown.

scenarios.journey: Backup, restore, login, startup, TLS and support
scenarios.requiredObservation: Private owner handoff names current backup freshness, recoverability, loss scope, restore/rollback, restart/login, TLS renewal, updates and outage support; no operational execution.
Owner selects audience and required rows, explicitly accepts exclusions/residual risks; incomplete or synthetic evidence cannot establish full acceptance.
